description: SwiftUI extension defining onboarding pages and UI components for the OpenClaw macOS application. Contains various onboarding steps such as welcome, connection setup, permissions, CLI installation, workspace configuration, chat interface, and final setup summary.

methods.name: pageView(for:)
methods.description: Returns the view for a specific onboarding page index, routing to specialized page functions.

methods.name: welcomePage()
methods.description: Builds the welcome page UI introducing OpenClaw and security notices.

methods.name: connectionPage()
methods.description: Builds the page UI to select and configure the connection gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDiscoverySection()
methods.description: Displays available gateways for remote connection discovery.

methods.name: advancedConnectionSection()
methods.description: Provides UI for advanced connection options including transport protocols and gateway URL configuration.

methods.name: permissionsPage()
methods.description: Displays permission requests and status for macOS capabilities needed by OpenClaw.

methods.name: cliPage()
methods.description: UI for installing and managing the OpenClaw CLI utility.

methods.name: workspacePage()
methods.description: Configures the agent workspace folder, including creating, opening, and saving settings.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage()
methods.description: Shows a dedicated onboarding chat view for user-agent interaction.

methods.name: readyPage()
methods.description: Summary page indicating setup is complete with actions and features for the user.

methods.name: maybeLoadOnboardingSkills()
methods.description: Loads onboarding skills data asynchronously if not already loaded.

methods.name: skillsOverview
methods.description: Displays a list and status of skills included in the setup.
